default_mode: plan-and-queue; external execution requires a host adapter and state-changing actions require explicit approval

A.description: Production, regulated, consequential, security-sensitive, legal/compliance, credential-bearing, or destructive work.

B.description: Reversible, non-production work that still requires evidence-backed verification.

recovery.rule: Retry only the smallest reversible corrective action and require new evidence after each retry.

execution_boundary.orchestrator: creates plans, queues actions, records approvals, emits host dispatch manifests, records results, coordinates recovery, and runs verification
execution_boundary.host: invokes connected execution tools using its own authorization and credential boundary
execution_boundary.credential_rule: The task store may contain a non-secret credential reference identifier but must never contain credentials, tokens, passwords, secrets, or private keys.

completion_rule: A task is complete only when observable success criteria are satisfied and the independent reliability verifier returns PASS, or returns HUMAN_REVIEW followed by recorded human release approval.
